label: Endless ascent: unbounded grades hold with the other uniqueness inputs and no unique necessary root
paraphrase: Closed control on one interpretation (one world; the natural numbers all exist, are concrete, ungrounded and in act in esse; the greater number is more in esse; nothing causes esse): the unbounded-grades rival holds; zero has a necessary root ancestor (itself); excluded middle holds; whatever is maximal in being causes the being of every other being (vacuously, there being no maximum); every existent is in act in esse; every distinct esse cause of an actual concretum is its actual concrete ground (vacuously); and there is no actual root that is necessary and unique. A statement about this interpretation only.
